headline: Elevator giant Otis wants to be a defensive play in a volatile market. It has to prove itself first
summary: Otis positions itself as a long-term growth stock, but shares are down due to setbacks in its elevator service business and investors chasing the AI trade.

headline: The business of Otis elevators
summary: Elevator giant Otis makes most of its profits from servicing elevators, not building new ones. The business hinges on long-term stability, but its stock has fallen over the past year due to setbacks in its service business and investors chasing the AI trade. Watch the video to learn more about how the company is trying to win back Wall Street.
